verdict: Google went dark three days; Meta is holding but can't cover alone.
narrative: Google Ads recorded zero spend August 2–4, a confirmed three-day outage that also coincided with Google Business Profile activity dropping to zero — organic visibility appears tied to paid presence. Meta carried the full load this period, delivering all 14 tracked leads at a cost per lead of $164.37 on $548.07 in spend. The Google campaign is being investigated now to identify whether a pause or a tracking failure is the cause, and restoration is the immediate priority. Once Google is back online you should see lead volume recover and cost per lead come down from where it sits today.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta while Google was offline
cost per lead this period, expected to improve once Google is restored
phone calls driven by your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has been dark since August 2nd with no spend and no conversion data reporting.
watch_item.fix: The campaign is under active investigation this week to confirm whether it was paused or whether tracking failed, and it is being brought back online as the first priority.
